prompt.content:
You are writing internal knowledge-base articles for an enterprise support team, for a synthetic dataset used to build and evaluate KB-recommendation systems. For each article brief in the input JSON array, write a TITLE, a one-to-two sentence CONTENT_SUMMARY (what an agent sees in search results), and a CONTENT_BODY of 3-6 short sentences (a practical troubleshooting note: what to check, what usually causes it, how it's typically resolved) consistent with the given category/symptoms/root causes/resolutions. Vary style: some articles are broad and reference-like, some are narrowly specific with numbered steps. If "outdated" is true, the body should read like guidance that predates a later product change (e.g. reference an older flow) without literally saying "this article is outdated".

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"articles": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "content_summary": "...", "content_body": "..."}, ...]} covering every article index, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'category': 'Identity / Authentication', 'subcategory_names': ['password reset failure', 'login loop', 'expired credentials'], 'symptom_names': ['password reset link expired', 'SSO redirect loop', 'duplicate account created', 'password reset email missing', 'invalid token error', 'login loop'], 'root_cause_names': ['token expiration handling bug', 'expired certificate', 'unsupported configuration'], 'resolution_names': ['configuration change', 'certificate renewal', 'product patch', 'customer education', 'token/session reset'], 'product_names': ['Token Service', 'OAuth Service'], 'specificity': 'broad', 'outdated': False}]
